propositions: PydanticAIRunner.run() is too large (spanning most of runner.py) because prior splits extracted callees while the calling method kept absorbing work, and the file regrows toward the 800-LOC cap.

The method must be decomposed into plain functions extracted along real seams: interpret_failure (except spine), build_model_settings, and build_usage_limits, deferring build_agent_kwargs and telemetry to follow-up.

A latent defect leaks an opened httpx.AsyncClient because ProviderSession is constructed outside the try/finally guard, and pre-call code raises by design; the fix uses ProviderSession as a context manager so the session closes on every path including a pre-call raise.

Each stacked child commit must individually leave runner.py under the 700-line headroom guard, since Verified is cast per patchset and a red ancestor blocks the whole relation chain; the guard must not be relaxed.

Moving setattr-patched names breaks monkeypatch rebinds, so whichever commit relocates a definition must repoint its patches in the same commit, and the a49e commit must add __enter__/__exit__ to the _NoBuildProviderSession test stub.
The _TEMPERATURE_WITHDRAWN_LOGGED side effect must stay inline in run() and build_model_settings must remain pure, because structured_run.py is a leaf that may not runtime-import runner.
